Name: Four Seasons Farm Map Custom Starter
Author: KatoraNoku
Description:
I decided to make this mod because I love the original mod so much, but starting by getting hay as a gift from the mayor is kind of strange. I also took the opportunity to change the starting furniture, because why not, right?

The following mods are required: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30062]Wildflour's Four Seasons Farm Map[/url] - Mod base that I modified.
﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14152]Custom Starter Package[/url] - Framework used to change the initial hay package to parsnips.
﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16729]Custom Starter Furniture[/url] - Framework used to change the furniture in the house into something more unique (?)

I would like to express my gratitude to the modder [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/aedenthorn?gameId=1303]Aedenthorn[/url] who, in addition to creating these frameworks, greatly assisted me by answering my questions and updating the mod; without him, it wouldn't have been possible and of course, thanks to the modder [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Wildflourmods?gameId=1303]Wildflour[/url], who created this wonderful farm for us to play on.
